get.summary: Get a list of providers near a position
get.description:
This endpoint supports two modes of querying. Depending on the query parameter you provide, a different result
will be returned.

| Query Parameter | Search Mode | Query Type | Result Type |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `specialty` | Ranked Search | `RankedProviderQuery` | `RankedProviderList` |
| `name` | Directory Search | `DirectorySearchQuery` | `DirectorySearchResultList` |
| `npi` | Directory Search | `DirectorySearchQuery` | `DirectorySearchResultList` |


### Ranked Search (Primary)

Performs a ranked query for a specialty near a specific `Position`. This will return 
results in rank-order, where the first `Provider` in the list is the most highly recommended based on distance, 
quality, cost, and patient reviews.

### Directory Search (Secondary)

Performs a lookup for a professional by name or NPI near a specific Position; facilities are not currently 
supported. **This will return results by relevance to the query. Providers returned are not necessarily
recommended by Garner.**

get.description:
This endpoint returns details about a single professional including quality data for each of the professional's specialties, 
and directory data for each location at which the professional practices.

schema.description: The Garner ID for the professional. It will always have the prefix `p.`

parameters.name: network_id
parameters.description: The list of networks to include on the professional response.

get.description:
This endpoint returns details about a single location of a facility including data for each of the facility's specialties 
and directory data for the requested location.

Note that one facility ID can be related to many different locations. This endpoint 
will only show data for one location of a facility, according to the location ID included on the request.

schema.description: The Garner ID for the facility. It will always have the prefix `f.`

parameters.name: location_id
parameters.description: The Garner location ID for a specific location of the requested facility ID.

parameters.name: network_id
parameters.description: The list of networks to include on the facility response.

lat.description: Latitude of the origin of the query. Must be combined with `lng`. Must not be combined with `zipCode`

lng.description: Longitude of the origin of the query. Must be combined with `lat`. Must not be combined with `zipCode`

zipCode.description: The center of this ZIP-5 code to use as the origin of the query. Must not be combined with `lat` or `lng`

plan.description: The data subscription plan associated with your account. Contact your account manager for the correct value to this parameter.

limit.description: The maximum number of providers to include in the response. Defaults to 15.

networkId.description: Filters results to a given carrier network when included.

gender.description: Filters results to a given gender. If omitted, no gender filter will be applied.

language.description: Filters results to require a given language to be spoken by the provider. If omitted, no language filter will be applied. Must be provided as a [ISO639-3](https://iso639-3.sil.org/code_tables/639/data) code.

providers.description: The result list of providers (professionals or facilities) for the request. The providers are in rank order.

firstName.description: First name of the provider. Only returned if provider is a professional rather than a facility

lastName.description: Last name of the provider. Only returned if provider is a professional rather than a facility

credentials.description: Degrees and certifications held by the provider. Only returned if provider is a professional rather than a facility

specialty.description: The specialty identifier for the provider

organizationName.description: Name of the facility. Only returned if provider is a facility rather than a professional

languages.description: List of languages spoken by the provider. Languages are [ISO639-3](https://iso639-3.sil.org/code_tables/639/data) codes. Only returned if provider is a professional rather than a facility,

metrics.description: Relevant metrics for the query. Will be repeated for each provider ranked for ease of comparison.

value.description: Performance on the metric. Providers will only be recommended by the API if they have at least a score of `good` on each metric

overallScore.description: Score for the provider taking into account overall quality and cost

reviewStars.description: Star-rating synthesizing the patient reviews for the provider

distanceMi.description: The driving distance to the location in miles

name.description: Name or partial name of the provider. Must not be combined with `npi`

npi.description: The unique identifier for the provider. Must not be combined with `name`

networkId.description:
When included, the `networkStatus` attribute of the result will indicate whether the physician is 
in-network with the given network.

gender.description: Filters results to a given gender. If omitted, no gender filter will be applied.

language.description: Filters results to require a given language to be spoken by the provider. If omitted, no language filter will be applied. Must be provided as a [ISO639-3](https://iso639-3.sil.org/code_tables/639/data) code.

providers.description: The result list of professionals for the request.

credentials.description: Degrees and certifications held by the provider. Only returned if provider is a professional rather than a facility

specialty.description: The specialty identifier for the provider

networkStatus.description: Whether the doctor is in-network with the network specified in the query parameters

languages.description: List of languages spoken by the provider. Languages are [ISO639-3](https://iso639-3.sil.org/code_tables/639/data) codes. Only returned if provider is a professional rather than a facility

distanceMi.description: The driving distance to the location in miles

Location.description: The office location of a provider

id.description: The unique identifier for this location

name.description: Name of the office or facility for the associated location and provider. Only returned if provider is a professional rather than a facility

providerCorporationName.description: The primary provider corporation (e.g. health system) affiliated with this location. When both `providerCorporationName` and `allProviderCorporations` are present, the value here is also included in `allProviderCorporations`. Only returned when the provider is a professional and the corporation is known.

allProviderCorporations.description: All provider corporations (e.g. health systems) the professional is affiliated with at this location. When `providerCorporationName` is also returned, it is the primary entry in this list. Only returned when the provider is a professional and at least one affiliation is known.

lines.description: The lines of an address, in order

Gender.description: Gender. Only returned if provider is a professional rather than a facility

DayOfWeek.description: ISO day of week (e.g. 1 is Monday)

WorkingHours.description: The days and times of day the provider's office is open

open.description: The time of day the office opens. Represented as minutes after midnight

close.description: The time of day the office closes. Represented as minutes after midnight

field.description: key of the field to be annotated

value.description: value of the field that is being annotated. It can either be a string or an object.

isCorrect.description: indicates whether the current value is correct or incorrect

correctedValue.description: Corrected value of the annotated field

annotations.description: List of annotations for the provider record

credentials.description: Degrees and certifications held by the provider

review_stars.description: Star-rating synthesizing the patient reviews for the provider

languages.description: List of languages spoken by the provider. Languages are [ISO639-3](https://iso639-3.sil.org/code_tables/639/data) codes

metrics.description: All metrics associated with all specialties practiced by the provider

specialties.description: A map of all specialties practiced by the provider keyed by the specialty identifier

locations.description: Map of all office locations of the provider keyed by the location id

lines.description: The lines of an address, in order

zip_code.description: The zip code of the address

hours.description: The days and times of day the provider's office is open

name.description: Name of the office or facility for the associated location and provider

accepts_new_patients.description: Whether the provider is accepting new patients at the location

availability_within_weeks.description: The number of weeks out a provider is scheduling new patients, if known

provider_corporation_name.description: The primary provider corporation (e.g. health system) affiliated with this location. When both `provider_corporation_name` and `all_provider_corporations` are present, the value here is also included in `all_provider_corporations`. Only present when the corporation is known.

all_provider_corporations.description: All provider corporations (e.g. health systems) the professional is affiliated with at this location. When `provider_corporation_name` is also present, it is the primary entry in this list. Only present when at least one affiliation is known.

overall_score.description: Score for the provider in the given specialty taking into account overall quality and cost

locations.description: List of locations where the provider practices the given specialty

location_id.description: Unique identifier for an office location. Can be used to obtain address information from the top level `locations` map

networks.description: List of networks included on the request. Each network will show both in-network and top-provider status

is_in_network.description: Whether the provider is in network for the given specialty at the given location

is_top_provider.description: Whether the provider is a top provider for the given specialty at the given location within the given network, taking into account cost and quality.

specialties.description: A map of all the facility location's specialties keyed by the specialty identifier
